# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 87 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Athous, Shepherd of Hermas 87 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_087_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 9 — A Night with the Virgins

**1** When the tower was complete, the tall man called me over. "Come," he said, "let's go and eat with the virgins." We sat down together at a table. He brought out twelve large bowls full of wine and set them on the table alongside bread, and he ate and drank with us. **2** When the meal was over, he called the virgins to him and said, "Watch over this man tonight — don't let him leave." Then the virgins turned to me and said, "You'll be staying with us tonight — as a brother, not as a husband. You are our brother, and from today we want you to live with us, because we love you deeply." **3** I was embarrassed about staying with them. But the one who seemed to lead them came and hugged me warmly, and when the others saw this, they all embraced me too. They took me around the tower and laughed and played with me. **4** Something wonderful happened — I felt young again, and I began to play and laugh with them. Some of them danced, others sang, and I walked among them in silence, circling the tower and sharing in their joy. **5** When evening came I wanted to leave and go inside, but they wouldn't let me go. We spent the whole night there together, and I slept in the tower. **6** The virgins spread their fine linen robes on the ground and had me lie down in the middle of them. They spent the whole night doing nothing but praying. I prayed continuously with them, and they were overjoyed to have me there. I stayed with the virgins until morning, when the Shepherd arrived.

---

*PNEUMA captures the remarkable tenderness of this scene — Hermas's renewal of youth in the company of the virtues, and the all-night prayer vigil.*
